description: Build an unsigned create-mint tx. Returns the base64 v0 transaction + lastValidBlockHeight + derived mint address.

decimals.description: Decimal places for the new mint. 9 matches SOL, 6 matches USDC.

extensions.description: Token-2022 extensions to enable. Omit entirely for program: spl-token.

closeAuthority.description: Whether the mint may later be closed by its authority.

confidentialTransfer.description: Whether to enable Token-2022 confidential transfers on the mint.

interestRateBps.description: Token-2022 interest rate in basis points; may be negative. Null for none.

transferFeeBps.description: Token-2022 transfer fee in basis points (100 = 1%), or null for none.

freezeAuthority.description: Whether the new mint gets a freeze authority. False makes accounts unfreezable forever.

mint.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

payer.description: A Solana address in base58, 32-44 chars.

name: solknife_create_mint_build
